task.title: Replay Demo from YAML scenarios and recorded SimConnect sessions
task.body:
## Outcome

Replace the Rust-hardcoded Demo scenario with deterministic playback of a repository-owned YAML scenario. Run a chosen scenario with:

```text
--source demo --scenario <path>
```

Recorded real SimConnect sessions can be used to prepare replayable demo scenarios.

## Requirements

- Add `demo_scenario.yaml` to the repository. It must represent every value, timing rule, phase, cycle, transition and unavailable-field case currently hardcoded in the Rust Demo provider, including attitude, coordinated turn, IAS/TAS/GS, speed profile/references, IAS acceleration, altitude/BARO, VSI, selected altitude and current/selected heading.
- Demo reads the scenario and plays it through the existing Publisher, HTTP/SSE and EFI pipeline. Remove the duplicated hardcoded scenario content from Rust; retain only generic parsing, validation and playback logic.
- Support `--scenario <path>` for `--source demo`. Without an explicit path, use the checked-in default scenario through a documented deployment-safe default; preserve the usual Demo startup.
- Provide a documented way to turn a selected recorded SimConnect log session into the same YAML scenario format. Select one session explicitly from appended logs, preserve event timing and missing/unavailable values, and exclude diagnostic-only records and local environment metadata from scenario data.
- Replayed sessions are clearly identified as Demo. They do not load SimConnect or represent a current live flight.
- Preserve one producer shared by clients, latest-state distribution, freshness semantics and controlled shutdown. Replaying a pause or data gap must not make cached samples look newly live.

## Implementation baseline and findings

This issue is self-contained and does not depend on local review notes or conversation history.
The implementation observations below refer to revision `122b9ffffc034953514a60efe8071d212a410ee8`, reviewed with PR #98.
Recheck the current implementation baseline before edits.

| Area | Observed implementation | Required work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scenario content | `src/providers/demo.rs` contains values and timing. `demo_scenario.yaml` is absent | Move scenario content to YAML and retain generic playback logic |
| Source configuration | `src/application.rs` uses parameterless `SourceSelection::Demo` | Pass typed Demo configuration through application composition |
| CLI | `src/bin/main.rs` and its test reject `--scenario` | Support the option for Demo and reject it with SimConnect |
| BARO | Producers, APIs, and fixtures still contain `baro_text` | Use only numeric `baro_setting.pressure_hpa` in the affected code and fixtures |
| Timing | Separate sample and freshness intervals run every 50 ms and skip missed ticks | Preserve freshness independently of sample publication and define replay scheduling |
| Default progression | Published sample index advances modulo 3960. Skipped ticks do not advance it by elapsed wall time | Preserve nominal default checkpoints and explicitly specify late-tick behavior |

The default full cycle contains 3960 samples at nominal 20 Hz, lasting 198 seconds.
The feature documentation owns the individual values, phases, and shorter cycles.
Do not copy obsolete implementation representations into YAML solely to reproduce existing fixtures.

### Established constraints

* Scenario files are runtime input data. Editing an explicit scenario requires no Rust source change or recompilation.
* Changes to application code or its supported contract require a coordinated rebuild of server, telemetry, and embedded browser.
* Use only numeric `baro_setting.pressure_hpa`. Missing or invalid pressure remains unavailable without `baro_text` fallback.
* Preserve independent instrument availability, one shared producer, latest-state delivery, freshness, and controlled shutdown.
* Preserve accepted instrument values. Missing separate device records do not reopen their acceptance.
* Use independent expected checkpoints. Do not derive expected results from the new parser or scenario under test.
* Replay uses `Source::Demo` and never loads SimConnect. A visible source badge is not required by this issue.
* Reject unsupported scenario formats or versions without maintaining legacy parsers or silent scenario substitution.

### Planning choices within this Work Item

Resolve these details during implementation planning. The alternatives are not additional approved product behaviors.

| Topic | Required planning result |
| --- | --- |
| Default delivery | Select embedding or a deployed file. Define path resolution and actionable failure behavior for deployment outside the repository |
| YAML structure | Specify timed samples or segments, fields, numeric validation, timestamp ordering, and repeat/end semantics |
| Format identification | Define supported-format identification and unsupported-version rejection without backward-compatibility adapters |
| Late ticks | Define pacing or sample skipping. Distinguish nominal default playback from recorded event timing and gaps |
| Conversion interface | Choose a documented procedure or tool, its location, explicit session selection, supported inputs, and output validation |
| Record mapping | Define which records supply observations, actual publications, lifecycle transitions, and unavailable values |
| Source identity | Verify Demo identity through the source/telemetry contract without introducing an unrequested browser badge |

### Recorded-data evidence boundaries

Apply these limits when selecting and converting diagnostic records:

* Schema 1–3 candidate live states do not establish actual live telemetry publication.
* Schema 2 cross-unit disagreement could invalidate samples. Account for this when interpreting recorded unavailable states.
* Schema 4 identifies enabled live publication. Schema identity alone does not prove integrated simulator or mobile acceptance.
* Do not infer publication semantics from a field name containing `candidate` alone.
* Select supported input schemas explicitly. Reject unsupported inputs rather than silently treating them as current records.
* Exclude diagnostic-only records and local environment metadata from scenario data.
* Preserve recorded timing, pauses, gaps, and independent missing values. Do not refresh cached values through replay ticks.
* Conversion must not depend on `validation_scope`, which #100 removes from diagnostic output.
* Replay verifies playback behavior. It does not establish physical acceleration truth, original painted browser frames, or device acceptance.
* Do not treat receipt timing as a universally confirmed cause of IAS spikes. This Work Item does not change the accepted estimator or prediction.

## Possible approach

Use a versioned YAML format describing timed samples or generic timed segments, with explicit repeat/end behavior and optional fields. First inventory the existing Rust Demo behavior and prove equivalent output from the default file against independent existing checkpoints.

A local conversion tool can read one real JSONL session, normalize source observations and lifecycle events, and write this same YAML format. Keep conversion separate from playback so the runtime has one scenario reader. The format and conversion details should be established during implementation planning; this section describes an approach, not a prescribed implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `demo_scenario.yaml` is committed and contains all current Demo scenario values and timing behavior; Rust no longer contains a second copy of that content.
- [ ] Default Demo and `--source demo --scenario <path>` both deliver the scenario through real HTTP/SSE to EFI.
- [ ] Existing independent Demo checkpoints continue to pass for the migrated default file, including cycles, boundary samples, optional fields and unavailable cases.
- [ ] A recorded SimConnect session can be converted to YAML and replayed with its timing and data availability preserved; session selection and conversion are documented.
- [ ] Explicit scenario changes appear in playback without Rust source edits or recompilation.
- [ ] Missing/unreadable/malformed scenarios and unsupported versions produce actionable errors without silently selecting another scenario; validate CLI combinations, timeline and numeric values.
- [ ] Timing, repeat/end behavior, pause/gap handling, equal fresh samples, multiple clients and shutdown have deterministic automated coverage.
- [ ] The normal application checks and affected browser runtime checks pass; documentation explains the default file, custom paths, conversion and Demo identification.
- [ ] No simulator, SDK or DLL is required for YAML playback. Generated real-session logs and local SDK paths are excluded from commits.

* [ ] YAML, conversion output, and fixtures use numeric BARO without legacy text fields or fallback.
* [ ] Typed library configuration supports scenario selection without reading process arguments inside the provider.
* [ ] Default selection works from a deployed location outside the repository. Explicit-file failures never select another scenario.
* [ ] Late-tick, repeat/end, and gap semantics are documented and verified using a controlled clock.
* [ ] Conversion tests distinguish supported diagnostic schemas, selected sessions, candidate observations, publications, and unavailable states.
* [ ] Conversion excludes diagnostic metadata and does not require `validation_scope`.
* [ ] Replay retains Demo source identity without adding a browser badge or loading SimConnect.
* [ ] Validation records identify the tested artifacts and evidence limits without relying on local review notes.

## Validation additions

Run the current Windows x64 MSVC application checks, Node tests, and complete release build.
Run both desktop browser scripts with the rebuilt release executable.
Use controlled clocks for scheduling, gaps, repeated equal samples, and shutdown.
Use fixtures with independent expectations for conversion and default-scenario equivalence.

Record the tested revision, commands, environment, selected session, diagnostic schema, and conversion result.
Retain artifact identities and missing checks in this issue or a durable linked validation record.
Do not commit generated real-session logs or environment metadata.
Automated playback tests remain independent of the simulator, SDK, and DLL.
Desktop results do not certify real-device or live-simulator behavior.

## Coordination

This Work Item can start independently of #100.
Use the accepted numeric `baro_setting.pressure_hpa` contract in scenarios, conversion output, fixtures, and affected APIs.
Update affected code and tests within this Task's scope. Do not migrate obsolete BARO text fields or add legacy fallbacks.
Planning and implementation do not require completion of #100.

Follow-up to the Demo and SimConnect integration under #9. The new Demo-only `--scenario` option intentionally replaces the previous rejection of that option; it does not add a SimConnect probe/scenario mode. Keep source configuration in the application/library boundary rather than reading process arguments inside the library.

## Reference documentation

The following pinned documents preserve the requirements reviewed with PR #98:

| Subject | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Default values, cycles, and planned playback | [Demo provider](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/122b9ffffc034953514a60efe8071d212a410ee8/docs/sources/demo.md) |
| Diagnostic record interpretation | [SimConnect diagnostic schemas](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/122b9ffffc034953514a60efe8071d212a410ee8/docs/sources/simconnect.md#diagnostic-schema-interpretation) |
| Numeric data, availability, and freshness | [Telemetry contract](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/122b9ffffc034953514a60efe8071d212a410ee8/docs/telemetry-contract.md) |
| Required validation | [Testing guide](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/122b9ffffc034953514a60efe8071d212a410ee8/docs/testing/index.md) |

## Execution handoff

The [first comment with the accepted implementation contract](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478) preserves the complete YAML format, runtime semantics, conversion mappings, rationale, and validation.
The descriptions of the following Subtasks define their outcomes and acceptance. Each first comment supplies additional detailed context.
No chat history, local plan, uncommitted file, or original real-session recording is required to understand the assignments.

| Subtask | Outcome | Prerequisites |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #123 | Implement the YAML format and migrate the default scenario | None |
| #124 | Integrate scenario playback and selection through EFI | #123 |
| #125 | Establish and record conversion evidence and mapping | None; mapping result established during planning |
| #126 | Convert a selected recorded session and replay it | #124 and #125 |

The selected mappings accept complete schema 4 diagnostic sessions as observation projection and schema 5 sessions as publication-observation replay.
They reject schemas 1-3 and untimed raw SSE input. No unresolved mapping investigation or recording-format change is required.
Implementation uses the accepted numeric BARO contract. Completion of #100 is not a prerequisite for this Task or its Subtasks.
Task completion still requires this Task's own playback, conversion, documentation, and validation criteria.

subtasks.title: Implement the YAML format and migrate the default scenario
subtasks.body:
Parent: #91 (Epic #9). No prerequisite issues or Subtasks.

Execution: one GPT-6.1 Terra agent at medium. Read the first comment on this issue and the [parent's accepted design](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
This assignment is self-contained in GitHub; local plans, unpublished documentation, and chat history are not prerequisites.

### Outcome

The existing default Demo publishes YAML-owned values through the production application and matches independent default-scenario checkpoints.
The validated scenario reader supports the accepted format for subsequent runtime integration.

### Scope

* Add repository-root `demo_scenario.yaml`, the typed reader, validation, embedded default, and data-backed default helpers.
* Replace all default scenario formulas, values, phases, profile tables, and helper cycle periods in production Rust with YAML data.
* Keep the existing default producer connected through `sample(index)` so the migrated data reaches real HTTP/SSE and EFI immediately.
* Preserve existing cadence, late-tick pacing, expiry, and shutdown during this migration. #124 owns the selected new clock.
* Exclude external-file application selection, `--scenario`, new runtime scheduling, converter implementation, and SimConnect changes.
* Preserve pre-existing work and the numeric BARO baseline. Do not restore options or wire fields removed by #122.

### Context

* [ADR 0010](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), particularly representation, parsing, default delivery, and existing helpers.
* [Demo scenario definitions](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/sources/demo.md#scenario-timing), [selected YAML format](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), and [planned library interfaces](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* [Telemetry fields](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/telemetry-contract.md#fields-and-conventions), [partial profiles](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/adr/0008-partial-airspeed-profile.md), and [application delivery](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/architecture.md#application-delivery-contract).
* `src/providers/demo.rs`, default-data callers, and the existing Demo checkpoint tests.
* Independent fixtures: `attitudes.json`, `pfd-samples.json`, `speed-samples.json`, `airspeed-profile.json`, and `speed-indications.json`.
* Independent fixtures: `altitude-samples.json`, `selected-altitude-samples.json`, `vertical-speed-samples.json`, and `heading-samples.json`.
* [Validation matrix](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/index.md#validation-by-change-scope) and [Demo checks](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/runtime.md#telemetry-and-demo-checks).

The earlier issue baseline `122b9ff` is historical. Use current APIs and numeric `baro_setting.pressure_hpa` without migrating legacy BARO text.

### Implementation guidance

1. Refresh current source code, required documentation, and issue artifacts before edits. Do not wait for #100's completion.
2. Capture matched default-scenario inputs and baseline screenshots before changing the source of scenario data.
3. Add typed parsing with `serde-saphyr` and commit the resolved lockfile. Check its license, toolchain compatibility, and parser controls.
4. Implement `Scenario::parse` with format, version, shape, timeline, numeric, and resource-budget validation under the accepted contract.
5. Embed the root YAML and parse it through the same reader available for external text. Do not add a separate default parser.
6. Encode all 3960 events and helper metadata. YAML anchors may share complete values; reject merge keys and inheritance.
7. Make `sample`, `attitude`, and `speed_profile` read parsed embedded data. Keep no Rust copy of scenario content or periods.
8. Validate the embedded default once before HTTP binding. Return an actionable preparation error rather than silently replacing invalid data.
9. Retain the existing index-paced runtime for this Subtask. Keep its generic expiry cadence separate from YAML-owned scenario timing.
10. Update the Demo documentation to identify the implemented reader and migration. Keep external selection and the new clock marked as planned.
11. Run required checks and independent implementation review under authorized delegation. Record the result and remaining Task criteria.

Routine module layout, initialization caching, and finite parser-budget constants belong to the developer.
Document supported limits and ensure they admit the complete default and intended custom inputs.
No permanent compatibility layer or duplicate scenario generator is required.


### Required format and migration decisions

* Use complete timed events in `demo_scenario.yaml`, with `format: msfs-efi-demo`, `version: 1`, integer microseconds, explicit duration, and `end: repeat|wait`.
* Embed the repository default with `include_str!` and use one typed reader for embedded and external text.
* Default data: 3960 events at 50000 microsecond spacing, first at zero, last at 197950000, repeat duration 198000000 microseconds.
* Keep `sample`, `attitude`, and `speed_profile` as data views. Store `reference.attitude_cycle_samples: 280` in YAML; do not duplicate scenario content in Rust.
* Required live event fields: `at_us`, `state: live`, `sample_age_us`, and complete `sample` with valid attitude. Non-live events have no sample or age field.
* Missing/null optional fields are unavailable, with no inheritance. Reject invalid present values, unknown/duplicate keys, extra YAML documents, merges, tags, unsupported formats, and unsafe timeline arithmetic.
* Anchors may share whole values. No expression/segment engine, legacy parser, or working-directory default search is required.
* Promote this accepted format and rationale into the Demo feature owner and playback ADR. The first comment supplies the full specification and example.

### Acceptance criteria

* [ ] Data ownership: YAML contains all default data and helper periods. Inspect production Rust for remaining scenario tables or formulas.
* [ ] Reader contract: Embedded text and synthetic external text use one parser and domain validator.
* [ ] Full cycle: Validate 3960 events, 50000 microsecond spacing, last at 197950000 microseconds, and duration 198000000 microseconds.
* [ ] Default equivalence: Independent fixtures pass for phase boundaries, inclusive `/59` sweeps, VSI omissions, optional values, shorter cycles, and repeated cycles.
* [ ] Helper behavior: The seven-pose helper repeats after the YAML-defined 280 samples. `sample` and `speed_profile` read YAML values.
* [ ] Invalid input: Wrong format/version, unknown or duplicate fields, invalid numbers/timestamps, unsupported tags, merges, and budget violations fail actionably.
* [ ] Optional data: Missing/null values stay unavailable; partial profiles and numeric BARO retain independent validation and replacement semantics.
* [ ] Startup and deployment: Invalid embedded data fails before HTTP binding or acquisition. The rebuilt executable uses the default outside the repository without a sibling YAML file.
* [ ] Production path: Default YAML data reaches real HTTP/SSE and embedded EFI. Match independent checkpoints and inspect required screenshots.
* [ ] Runtime preserved: Existing index-paced cadence, skipped-tick behavior, equal fresh samples, shared clients, freshness, and shutdown checks still pass.
* [ ] Handoff: Record reader APIs, parser budgets, validated default artifact identity, results, and any consequential mismatch for #124.


### Validation

* Run the application validation listed below, including the complete release build and both desktop browser scripts.
* Use independent fixtures as the oracle. Do not derive expectations from the new YAML file or its parser.
* Keep reader rejection tests separate from expected unavailable optional data.
* Compare matched baseline/candidate captures and inspect any affected scenes.
* Obtain independent review of the migration diff under the applicable authorization. Tests and review remain part of this Subtask.
* Record revision, executable identity, environment, commands, fixture identities, screenshots, results, and missing checks.
* These checks establish migrated default behavior, not custom runtime selection, converted-session fidelity, or phone/simulator acceptance.


### Complete application validation

Run the following complete application checks on Windows x64 MSVC after implementation:


```powershell
$env:RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN = 'stable'
$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET = 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --all-targets
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
cargo build --locked --release
```

Run both desktop scripts against the rebuilt release application:

```powershell
node tests/browser/pfd-browser.mjs
node tests/browser/pfd-runtime-browser.mjs target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/msfs2024-artificial-horizon.exe
```

* Configure Playwright and the browser through the [desktop procedure](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/pfd.md#responsive-efi-layout-and-desktop-checks).
* Subtask 1 checks the YAML-backed default. Subtask 2 adds production-path coverage for `--scenario`. Subtask 4 checks converted input.
* Do not infer custom-file or converted-file integration from default-only scripts or injected browser fixtures.
* Use paused Tokio clocks for timeline and age assertions. Keep expected values independent of the new parser and YAML under test.
* Compare matched baseline/candidate screenshots for affected scenes. Record causes only where evidence supports them.
* Select meaningful negative controls where an assertion could pass despite using the wrong file, current-time stamping, or an override.
* Obtain a separate review of each exact integrated code diff under [project-review-change](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/.agents/skills/project-review-change/SKILL.md). Record missing authorization or capability explicitly.
* Repeat affected checks after corrections. Run the complete applicable suite and review after each implementation outcome.
* Verify the combined application and converter before Task completion. Reuse earlier evidence only under the documented evidence-reuse rules.
* Preserve established mobile and instrument-value acceptance. Desktop replay checks do not establish new live-simulator or real-device acceptance.
* Planning experiments do not replace these implementation checks. Record unperformed checks explicitly.

subtasks.title: Integrate scenario playback and selection through EFI
subtasks.body:
Parent: #91 (Epic #9). Blocked by #123.

Execution: one GPT-6.1 Terra agent at medium. Read the first comment on this issue and the [parent's accepted design](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
This assignment is self-contained in GitHub; local plans, unpublished documentation, and chat history are not prerequisites.

### Outcome

Default and explicit YAML scenarios play on the accepted clock through the real application, with correct freshness, lifecycle, selection, and shutdown.

### Scope

* Implement typed Demo configuration, explicit-file loading, application composition, `--scenario`, and the generic runtime engine.
* Replace index-paced runtime scheduling with absolute event deadlines, acquisition-aware publication, repeats, gaps, and finite completion.
* Reuse #123's parser and default data. Preserve existing helpers as data views without using them for custom-file playback.
* Preserve one shared producer, latest-state delivery, numeric BARO, source identity, HTTP availability, and controlled shutdown.
* Exclude conversion, diagnostic changes, browser badges, estimator changes, presentation redesign, and unrelated test refactoring.

### Context

* #123's execution results, validated default artifact, reader APIs, parser budgets, and unresolved findings.
* [ADR 0010 timing decision](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* [Planned configuration and APIs](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), [clock and completion](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), and [playback semantics](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* [Application composition](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/architecture.md#application-composition), [ADR 0007](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/adr/0007-application-composition.md), and [freshness](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/telemetry-contract.md#freshness-and-status).
* `src/providers/demo.rs`, `src/application.rs`, `src/bin/main.rs`, `src/telemetry.rs`, and their consumers.
* Runtime, CLI, HTTP/SSE, independent instrument fixtures, and browser integration tests from the refreshed baseline.
* [Validation matrix](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/index.md#validation-by-change-scope) and [evidence selection](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/evidence.md#select-evidence-by-failure-risk).

The merged #122 baseline removed wire `schema_version`, shutdown-file support, and diagnostic size options.
Preserve current behavior rather than restoring those features from the dirty experimental tree.

### Implementation guidance

1. Verify #123's evidence and refresh the execution context. Capture matched baseline inputs and screenshots for changed runtime behavior.
2. Implement `DemoConfig::prepare()` for the embedded default or explicit path. Resolve relative paths against the caller's working directory.
3. Complete `SourceSelection::Demo(DemoConfig)` and `demo::run(scenario, publisher, shutdown)` under the documented typed interfaces.
4. Read and validate once before HTTP binding. Keep HTTP configuration in `Config` and argument parsing in the CLI.
5. Preserve bind-before-acquisition startup, source-failure isolation, channel lifetime, and the caller-owned shutdown future.
6. Add `--scenario` for explicit or implicit Demo. Reject it with SimConnect and preserve other current CLI constraints.
7. Implement absolute monotonic deadlines with intended acquisition time equal to the event instant minus `sample_age_us`.
8. Preserve snapshot-time expiry and independent 50 ms freshness checks. Never timestamp a cached or delayed acquisition as newly received.
9. Process equal-time and overdue events in file order. Bound work between shutdown and expiry checks and retain latest-state coalescing.
10. Implement `repeat` with continuous sequence numbering. Implement `wait` without ending the provider or triggering failed-producer recovery.
11. Update README and Demo usage, APIs, and timing documentation. State the deliberate replacement of late-tick stretching.
12. Run focused checks and the complete integrated validation. Obtain independent code review under authorized delegation.

No provider registry, alternate telemetry endpoint, history queue, segment evaluator, or compatibility adapter is required.


### Required application and clock interfaces

* `DemoConfig { scenario: Option<PathBuf> }`; `DemoConfig::prepare() -> Result<Scenario, DemoError>`; `SourceSelection::Demo(DemoConfig)`.
* `Scenario::parse(text: &str) -> Result<Scenario, DemoError>` and `demo::run(scenario, publisher, shutdown) -> Result<(), DemoError>`.
* Read once before HTTP binding. Explicit relative paths use the caller's working directory. Any explicit failure returns an actionable error without fallback.
* Schedule absolute monotonic event deadlines. For live events, acquisition time equals intended event instant minus `sample_age_us`, never the current publication time.
* Preserve `publish_sample_at`, the snapshot-time stale guard, and separate 50 ms expiry checks. Optional-only updates retain the preceding acquisition instant.
* Process equal-time/overdue events in file order with bounded work between shutdown checks. Slow clients may skip publications through the existing latest-state channel.
* Repeat at declared duration with continuous sequence. Finite `wait` stops scenario events but keeps producer, HTTP, expiry, and shutdown alive.
* This deliberately replaces late-tick stretching after the migration stage. Preserve nominal default checkpoints and all existing instrument values.

### Acceptance criteria

* [ ] Typed preparation: Library selection receives Demo configuration without reading process arguments. Invalid input fails before binding or acquisition.
* [ ] Default deployment: The rebuilt executable launches from an unrelated directory without a deployed YAML dependency.
* [ ] Explicit selection: Relative and absolute paths select only that file. Change a value, restart the same executable, and observe it without rebuilding.
* [ ] Failure behavior: Missing/unreadable files, malformed or unsupported scenarios, and incompatible CLI options fail actionably without substitution.
* [ ] Nominal timing: Controlled-clock checks cover initial waiting, first publication, just-before and exact deadlines, equal-time order, and cycle boundaries.
* [ ] Late timing: Advance across several deadlines. Intended acquisition age survives, including unavailable snapshots before the next expiry tick.
* [ ] Fresh versus cached: Equal fresh events renew age; optional-only updates preserve acquisition time; a 1000 ms gap becomes stale without cached republishing.
* [ ] Lifecycle: Paused, invalid, waiting, and disconnected events clear data without renewing age. Recovery requires an eligible live event.
* [ ] Repeat and completion: Repeats retain continuous sequence and valid acquisition ordering. `end: wait` retains HTTP, expiry, and shutdown until requested.
* [ ] Shared clients: Two real SSE clients share one progression. A slow client does not affect producer timing or introduce history buffering.
* [ ] Source and shutdown: All replay reports `source: demo` without loading SimConnect. Shutdown works during gaps, waits, repeats, and overdue batches.
* [ ] Integrated EFI: Default and explicit files reach real HTTP/SSE and embedded browser modules. Inspect required screenshots.
* [ ] Regression coverage: #123's independent default checkpoints and numeric/optional contracts remain valid.
* [ ] Evidence: Record revision, executable identity, commands, environment, scenarios, assertions, review results, captures, and unavailable checks.


### Validation

* Run the application validation listed below on the integrated runtime and data migration.
* Use paused Tokio clocks for timing, expiry, repeat/end behavior, equal fresh samples, cached updates, and shutdown.
* Add production-path browser coverage for `--scenario`; injected browser fixtures alone do not establish file-selection integration.
* Use meaningful negative controls for wrong-file selection, fallback, and publication-time freshness where they expose ineffective assertions.
* Compare matched baseline/candidate captures. Record causes only when evidence establishes them.
* Obtain independent review of the integrated runtime diff and review material corrections under the applicable authorization.
* Record combined default/custom evidence. These checks do not establish conversion fidelity or new simulator/device acceptance.


### Complete application validation

Run the following complete application checks on Windows x64 MSVC after implementation:


```powershell
$env:RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN = 'stable'
$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET = 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --all-targets
node --test tests/*.test.mjs
cargo build --locked --release
```

Run both desktop scripts against the rebuilt release application:

```powershell
node tests/browser/pfd-browser.mjs
node tests/browser/pfd-runtime-browser.mjs target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/msfs2024-artificial-horizon.exe
```

* Configure Playwright and the browser through the [desktop procedure](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/pfd.md#responsive-efi-layout-and-desktop-checks).
* Subtask 1 checks the YAML-backed default. Subtask 2 adds production-path coverage for `--scenario`. Subtask 4 checks converted input.
* Do not infer custom-file or converted-file integration from default-only scripts or injected browser fixtures.
* Use paused Tokio clocks for timeline and age assertions. Keep expected values independent of the new parser and YAML under test.
* Compare matched baseline/candidate screenshots for affected scenes. Record causes only where evidence supports them.
* Select meaningful negative controls where an assertion could pass despite using the wrong file, current-time stamping, or an override.
* Obtain a separate review of each exact integrated code diff under [project-review-change](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/.agents/skills/project-review-change/SKILL.md). Record missing authorization or capability explicitly.
* Repeat affected checks after corrections. Run the complete applicable suite and review after each implementation outcome.
* Verify the combined application and converter before Task completion. Reuse earlier evidence only under the documented evidence-reuse rules.
* Preserve established mobile and instrument-value acceptance. Desktop replay checks do not establish new live-simulator or real-device acceptance.
* Planning experiments do not replace these implementation checks. Record unperformed checks explicitly.

subtasks.title: Establish recorded-session conversion evidence and mapping
subtasks.body:
Parent: #91 (Epic #9). No prerequisite Subtasks. The selected mapping is already established; preserve its result and evidence limits.

Execution: one GPT-6.1 Terra agent at medium. Read the first comment on this issue and the [parent's accepted design](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
This assignment is self-contained in GitHub; local plans, unpublished documentation, and chat history are not prerequisites.

### Outcome

Record the selected converter inputs, command, mappings, clock, errors, and fidelity limits as a durable completed planning result.
#126 no longer depends on future investigation or new recording features.

### Scope

* Assess the current schema 4 writer and the available schema 5 recordings without changing application code or recording behavior.
* Establish complete-session selection, lifecycle, optional indications, acquisition identity, deterministic expiry, and output validation.
* Keep real-session artifacts and environment metadata local. Keep real recordings and environment metadata outside commits and public comments.

### Context

* [Accepted conversion decision](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* [Canonical conversion contract](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), including both schema mappings and raw optional indices.
* Remote `2a66b7f`: `src/providers/simconnect/runtime.rs`, `journal.rs`, `native.rs`, `instruments.rs`, and `lifecycle.rs`.
* [Telemetry freshness](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/telemetry-contract.md#freshness-and-status) and current numeric BARO/partial-profile contracts.
* The first comment on this issue preserves the prior experiment summary and independent synthetic expectations. No local evidence file is required.

Required issue bodies, comments, artifact lists, parent relationship, child list, and remote `main` were refreshed for this amendment.
They retain the identities and empty artifact/comment results recorded in the baseline table.

### Implementation guidance

The following decisions are settled. Confirm their source correspondence and preserve them; do not reopen them as an unbounded investigation:

| Boundary | Selected contract |
| --- | --- |
| Command | Rust `demo-convert --input <jsonl> --session <exact-id> --output <yaml>`; no implicit latest session or prefix-conversion option |
| Library | `demo::convert_session(reader: impl BufRead, session_id: &str) -> Result<Scenario, ConversionError>` |
| Writer | `Scenario::write_yaml(writer: impl Write) -> Result<(), DemoError>`; use the existing scenario representation and validation |
| Input | Diagnostic schemas 4 and 5, with enabled live publication and a complete selected session. Reject schemas 1-3 and untimed SSE |
| Session structure | One selected start/end, record numbers contiguous from zero, nondecreasing integer microseconds, no interleaving or duplicate selected identity |
| Output | `msfs-efi-demo`, version 1, unchanged event schema, `end: wait`, duration equal to recorded end plus one microsecond |
| Acquisition clock | Eligible normalized attitude observation timestamp. Reuse it for optional-only publications; equal fresh observations advance it |
| Source identity | Discard source identity and sequence from input payloads. Runtime playback supplies Demo identity and its own continuous sequence |
| Numeric data | Current validated numeric sample fields only. Convert raw inHg numerically; never parse legacy display text |
| Writing | Validate and serialize before exclusive output creation. Parent must exist; do not overwrite. Remove only a newly created partial output on write failure |

Schema 4 uses `simconnect::recorded` beside the existing pure `Lifecycle` and `Instruments` types.
The library's Demo conversion entry calls this internal module; neither it nor the binary loads native resources.
Expose only the internal access needed for normalization and next-expiry queries.

Schema 4 mapping:

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Successful `SimConnect_Open` API result | Start a connection generation; connect lifecycle and clear prior caches |
| Dispatch Event 10/11 | Apply Sim-running / pause flags |
| Dispatch Filename 12; SystemState 20/21 | Apply flight transition / queried Sim or flight state; clear caches on flight changes |
| Normalized `attitude_sample` | Apply validated canonical attitude or validation failure. Require nonhypothesis records |
| `instrument_sample` | Apply validated index/name and classified raw value only while recorded and projected lifecycle are active |
| Failed `instrument_request`; `instrument_unavailable` | Remove the affected optional field and dependent indications |
| `connection_lost` | Disconnect and clear cached data |
| `state_transition.published` | Preserve unavailable-state observations and compare complete snapshots as checkpoints; never silently retime mismatches |
| Raw/probe/metadata records | Generate no duplicate sample. Exclude diagnostic and environment data from YAML |

Evaluate each semantic observation and known intervening expiry deadlines with a synthetic monotonic clock.
Run expiry before equal-time input and preserve file order among equal-time records.
Emit full samples for new eligible attitude, optional changes, and optional expiry while attitude remains eligible.
Retain the attitude timestamp on those optional-only events. After an unavailable checkpoint, require a new eligible attitude to restore live.
Keep a separate live gate closed until that observation. If pure evaluation appears live while closed, retain the latest unavailable state.
Do not add periodic live resampling or infer disconnect from an isolated native error.

Use the canonical [raw optional mapping](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478) for indices 0-16.
It preserves one-second optional expiry, the accepted 500 ms/256-entry IAS history, acceleration expiry, and autopilot/radio-altitude target gates.
No missing reference speed, fixed VNE, or VSI is invented.

Schema 5 maps each actual publication payload at its record timestamp.
Associate each live publication with the latest matching valid normalized attitude in its connection generation.
Track lifecycle controls through the same pure rules without emitting additional events. Only active normalized observations can establish candidate eligibility.
Clear eligibility on unavailable publications, pause/resume, Sim changes, flight transitions, disconnect, and connection reset.
Reject missing/mismatched observations and unsupported snapshot fields; do not infer age by subtracting `sample_age_ms`.
Keep missing optional values unavailable, numeric BARO unchanged, and raw/transition records out of the event stream.

The input scanner rejects malformed selected records and incomplete selected sessions.
It can ignore an earlier interrupted fragment only when a subsequent valid session boundary proves it belongs outside the selected session.
Report excluded fragments, completed source failures, and checkpoint differences outside YAML; do not depend on `validation_scope`.

### Acceptance criteria

* [ ] Current inputs identified: Remote schema 4 source and untimed SSE writer inspected; available schema 5 logs distinguished from the application baseline.
* [ ] Interfaces and errors resolved: Exact command, library/writer interfaces, complete-session policy, supported versions, selection, and output behavior selected.
* [ ] Mapping demonstrated: Four complete schema 5 sessions mapped to 30862 events with matching attitudes and nonregressing observation times.
* [ ] Freshness distinguished: Those sessions contain 1714 fresh attitude observations and 29132 cached optional updates; the prototype retains the corresponding observation identity.
* [ ] Schema 4 rules grounded: Existing pure lifecycle, normalization, optional expiry, targets, and estimator inspected. The synthetic trace fixes independent expected boundary results.
* [ ] Limits explicit: Schema 4 is observation projection; schema 5 preserves publication payloads at journal time. Neither reconstructs exact native receipt or original browser paint.
* [ ] Next work executable: #126 contains selected decisions and checks. No additional diagnostic format or investigation is required.


### Validation

* The prototype checked records, monotonic time, matching attitudes, and acquisition-time continuity in four complete schema 5 sessions.
* The prototype produced 30862 events, including 30846 live events, without a missing matching observation or acquisition-time regression.
* A lifecycle-aware follow-up confirmed all 30846 live publications had active same-generation candidate observations.
* Controlled counterexamples rejected paused-candidate recovery and retained an unavailable checkpoint until a fresh eligible attitude.
* The selected example has 11619 records, 3781 events, 210 fresh attitude observations, and 3567 cached updates.
* Its diagnostic SHA-256 is `6622fe1ac4ced7580fd6caef321cef0578ecd0517f836527654fee1c17076b5b`. Original real-session inputs are optional supporting evidence, not a handoff prerequisite.
* Canonical source mappings and synthetic timing arithmetic were checked. A Rust schema 4 converter was not implemented or executed.
* The local event projection is JSON-shaped scenario data. It was not validated by the future YAML parser or replayed through the application.
* Source failures without publication records and interrupted sessions do not establish successful conversion and are rejected by the selected contract.
* No application suite, browser, simulator, SDK, or DLL run was performed for this mapping investigation.

subtasks.title: Convert a selected recorded session to YAML and replay it
subtasks.body:
Parent: #91 (Epic #9). Blocked by #124 and #125. No unresolved mapping decision remains.

Execution: one GPT-6.1 Terra agent at medium. Read the first comment on this issue and the [parent's accepted design](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
This assignment is self-contained in GitHub; local plans, unpublished documentation, and chat history are not prerequisites.

### Outcome

The Rust `demo-convert` command extracts one supported diagnostic session into validated YAML and replays it through the production Demo path.
Timing, gaps, optional availability, and freshness follow the selected schema-specific observation contract.

### Scope

* Add the thin Rust binary, reusable conversion API, YAML serialization, source mappings, input/output errors, tests, and usage documentation.
* Support exactly diagnostic schemas 4 and 5 under the [conversion contract](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* Reuse pure `Lifecycle` and `Instruments` logic internally for schema 4. Use complete publication payloads and matching attitude observations for schema 5.
* Keep `Source::Demo`, numeric BARO, one runtime scenario reader, and the accepted estimator unchanged.
* Exclude changes to recording protocols, raw SSE capture, native loading, simulator control, or historical GitHub issues.
* Keep generated real-session logs, scenarios, identifiers, local paths, and environment metadata outside commits.

### Context

* [ADR 0010 conversion decision](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* [Conversion interface/input](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), [clock](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), [schema 4](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), [raw fields](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478), and [schema 5](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/issues/91#issuecomment-6696677478).
* #125's decisions, source findings, independent trace, and actual evidence limits in this handoff.
* Subtasks 1 and 2's reader, serializer representation, playback interfaces, parser budgets, and integrated acceptance evidence.
* `src/providers/simconnect/{runtime,journal,native,lifecycle,instruments}.rs`, `src/providers/demo.rs`, `Cargo.toml`, and CLI tests.
* [Validation matrix](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/index.md#validation-by-change-scope) and [evidence selection](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/docs/testing/evidence.md#select-evidence-by-failure-risk).

Required implementation interfaces:

| Owner | Interface or rule |
| --- | --- |
| `src/bin/demo-convert.rs` | Required `--input`, `--session`, and `--output`; relative paths use the working directory; nonzero exit on conversion/output errors |
| `providers::demo` | `convert_session(reader: impl BufRead, session_id: &str) -> Result<Scenario, ConversionError>` |
| `Scenario` | `write_yaml(writer: impl Write) -> Result<(), DemoError>`; validate before writing and serialize the existing event representation |
| Internal `simconnect::recorded` | Schema-specific interpretation and pure projection. No native calls, worker startup, Publisher, or process arguments |
| `ConversionError` | Input/session/record/schema/timing/semantic errors with line or record identity where applicable. No silent fallback |
| `Cargo.toml` | Add `demo-convert` while preserving the existing default executable. Enable serialization on the selected YAML dependency if not already enabled |

### Implementation guidance

1. Refresh issue/artifact context, prerequisite results, source code, and the accepted mapping before edits.
2. Implement exact session scanning with complete-session, ordering, duplicate-identity, and selected-corruption checks.
3. Apply schema 4's source-observation projection through existing pure rules and deterministic expiry queries.
4. Apply schema 5's publication mapping and matching active same-generation attitude observations. Track lifecycle controls without emitting duplicate events.
5. Use `sample_age_us` to preserve observation identity across cached updates. Keep monotonic offsets and checked end-plus-one duration.
6. Whitelist supported telemetry fields and emit numeric BARO only. Exclude source metadata, wire bookkeeping, `baro_text`, and diagnostic-only records.
7. Validate events through the common reader model and serialize YAML through `Scenario::write_yaml`.
8. Add the typed CLI and exclusive output creation. Validate before creation; clean up only its own new partial file after write failure.
9. Report selected schema, event count, input exclusions, source failure, and checkpoint differences outside the scenario.
10. Add independent synthetic fixtures and rejection tests. Use available complete real logs as optional local integration inputs without committing them.
11. Replay a selected real conversion through the rebuilt application and EFI, identifying its schema and timing basis.
12. Document command syntax, supported inputs, selection, boundaries, numeric mapping, output validation, and recorded-time limits.
13. Run applicable checks and obtain independent implementation review under the applicable authorization. Record remaining Task criteria separately.

Routine module layout and budget constants belong to the developer.
Do not redesign the input format, add prefix modes, modify the estimator, or create new recording requirements during this Subtask.

### Acceptance criteria

* [ ] Explicit selection: Two appended complete sessions require exact selection and never share samples, connection state, or optional caches.
* [ ] Input failure: Reject schemas 1-3, untimed SSE, missing/duplicate selectors, malformed selected data, record gaps, backward times, and missing selected end.
* [ ] Interrupted other session: A valid later selected session converts after an unambiguously unrelated interrupted fragment. Report its exclusion.
* [ ] Output protection: Existing output and missing parent fail without changing files. Serialization failure creates no output; write failure removes only the command's new partial file.
* [ ] Schema 4 lifecycle: Synthetic records cover connection, Sim, pause, flight identity, invalid attitude, stale, disconnect, and fresh-sample recovery.
* [ ] Schema 4 instruments: Independent expectations cover every raw index, units, nonfinite/unavailable values, partial profiles, target gates, and expiry.
* [ ] Schema 5 mapping: Each publication yields one ordered event with matching live payload and same-generation observation age. Reject missing or mismatched attitudes.
* [ ] Equal versus cached: New equal attitudes advance acquisition time. Optional-only records/publications preserve it and cannot delay attitude expiry.
* [ ] Time boundaries: Retain record offsets/equal-time order, deterministic expiry, gaps, and `end: wait` at recorded end plus one microsecond.
* [ ] Numeric contract: Output has numeric BARO without text parsing/fallback and contains no source sequence, wire version, identity, reported age, or environment metadata.
* [ ] Shared format: The existing scenario validator accepts output with no separate runtime parser or format adapter.
* [ ] Production replay: Converted schema 5 real-session YAML reaches real HTTP/SSE and EFI as Demo, without a simulator, SDK, or DLL.
* [ ] Documentation and evidence: Record revision, artifact identities, commands, selected schema/session, completeness, timing comparisons, captures, review, and missing checks.


### Validation

Use the following independent timing trace for schema 4; raw lifecycle setup is active before the first attitude:

| Observation or deadline | Expected result |
| --- | --- |
| Attitude at 100000 microseconds | Live, acquisition age zero |
| IAS 100, 100.5, 101 at 150000, 400000, 650000 microseconds | Acceleration 2 kt/s at 650000; attitude age remains 550000 microseconds |
| Equal new attitude at 700000 microseconds | Age resets to zero without changing angles |
| Acceleration expiry at 1150000 microseconds | Acceleration unavailable; IAS still 101; attitude age 450000 microseconds |
| IAS expiry at 1650000 microseconds | IAS unavailable; attitude age 950000 microseconds |
| Attitude expiry at 1700000 microseconds | Stale, not 2650000 or another optional-update deadline |
| Pause at 1800000; attitude at 1850000; resume at 1900000 microseconds | Paused observation cannot restore live; resume waits for a fresh attitude |
| New attitude at 1950000 microseconds | Live with no retained IAS from before pause |

Additional required independent checks:

* BARO raw 29.92 inHg maps to approximately 1013.207489 hPa using the accepted constant, never display text.
* Heading -1 maps to 359 degrees; ball 63.5 maps to 0.5. Invalid ball/pressure does not invalidate valid altitude.
* AP available 1 plus selected altitude 3000 and radio mode 0 exposes 3000; mode 1 removes it.
* Missing VS0 or VR does not remove an independent valid redline. Do not fill missing thresholds from Demo.
* Test equal-time expiry/input ordering, explicit unavailable checkpoints, classification errors, and unexpected index/name pairs.
* A stale checkpoint must block cached live restoration by optional updates, even if envelope timestamps make pure evaluation appear live.
* Reject a schema 5 live publication whose matching candidate was observed during pause, even after a same-generation resume.
* Test complete source-failure sessions with replayable data separately from sessions with no replayable records.
* Use a temporary regression fault where it proves cached timestamp, session mixing, or metadata-exclusion assertions are effective.
* Apply the application validation listed below and converter CLI tests without a simulator or DLL.
* Test actual YAML output through the parser and production application; the planning JSON prototype does not supply that acceptance.
* Inspect required browser captures and obtain independent review of the exact implementation diff.
* Keep real data local. Synthetic schema 4 results do not establish a physical schema 4 session or original browser-frame reproduction.


### Complete application validation

Run the following complete application checks on Windows x64 MSVC after implementation:


```powershell
$env:RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN = 'stable'
$env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET = 'x86_64-pc-windows-msvc'
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --all-targets
node --test tests/*.test.mjs

node tests/browser/pfd-browser.mjs
node tests/browser/pfd-runtime-browser.mjs target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/msfs2024-artificial-horizon.exe
```

* Obtain a separate review of each exact integrated code diff under [project-review-change](https://github.com/LeszekKantorek/msfs2024-artificial-horizon/blob/2a66b7f7730d59cca15ecd381e14c5e21a5ef92b/.agents/skills/project-review-change/SKILL.md). Record missing authorization or capability explicitly.
* Repeat affected checks after corrections. Run the complete applicable suite and review after each implementation outcome.
* Verify the combined application and converter before Task completion. Reuse earlier evidence only under the documented evidence-reuse rules.
